messages.subject: endotherm model conduction issue
parts:
Dear NicheMapR users,

We've found an issue with the way conduction is implemented in the endoR and endoR_devel models and we are in the process of fixing it. Conduction is not on by default so this is only something to worry about if you are turning conduction on in the model. We'll let you know when we've fixed the problem but for now it's best to turn conduction off. Sorry for any bother this might have caused.

All the best,
Mike
